limits: No browser automation or screenshot capture in this agent; root performs actual UI checks through CUA.
AI generation, real Google/Kakao OAuth redirects/callback exchange, cloud password flows and hardware camera/microphone were not invoked.
Interview answer route used feedbackTiming=end, followups=false, interviewerReactions=false; cancel was used after persistence so configured providers could not generate end-of-interview coaching.
Dedicated study-report finalization was fully tested through HTTP. Provider-generated interview report feedback was excluded.
Existing quiz-api uploads synthetic media; excluded per scoped no-media instruction. Safe quiz behavior is covered by dedicated HTTP E2E and pure/component tests.
Existing security-ai/interview-v2 test scripts write seeded tester sessions and expect absent provider keys; excluded in favor of exact disposable fixtures.
Build and final browser QA are handled by root after visual fixes.

Native select retains keyboard/validation fallback and progressive base-select enhancement.

General Modal uses native dialog and keyboard boundary handling, Escape cancel, and focus restoration.

AppShell supplies skip-to-content link, Korean-labelled main/tools nav, aria-current, and visible account controls.
